kazakhstanPrivacyGate.observation: The current primary law text includes Article 12(2), requiring storage of personal data in a database or digital object located in Kazakhstan. Article 16 separately regulates cross-border transfers. Its exceptions must not be treated as an automatic exemption from Article 12 localization.
